comment: The short cut (Promo2026-*-Short), 41 beats = 20.5 s, no voice. It opens on the end of the story (the father's lock screen) and rewinds to how he knew; then payment, the director's morning, the call to action. `from` is the beat of the full scene the short starts it at. scripts/promo-2026/make-temp-track.mjs short reads this file, so the music follows any retiming.
